Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.
Tim tries to return a lost walkie-talkie to its owner.
When Grandma gives Tim a hat she made herself, Tim is super excited, but unfortunately it keeps getting in the way.
When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.
Using magic, Holly makes Lucy small enough to play in the Little Kingdom. Lucy has fun flying on Gaston the Ladybird and is invited to a sleepover at the Little Castle.
King Thistle is bored in the Royal Castle and takes up the hobby of birdwatching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.
Grandad's gnomes go missing. The mystery deepens when Stan finds a tiny human handprint! The gnomes can't really have come to life, can they?!
Melanie won't go to her favourite beach because of a strange sound known as The Wizard's Whistle! Is it a bird? Is it a kettle? Stan and Gran investigate!
When an unhappy Merpup tries to float Puplantis to the surface, it's up to the PAW Patrol and their newest member Coral to save the city and stop him.
Tracker and the Air Rescue Pups team up to save a Mother Tree in the jungle. The PAW Patrol races to fix Mr Porter's ice cream truck freezer before everything melts.
Jade's powerful Cool Crystal is stolen by Baron Bite, who then uses it to summon a blizzard. The twins receive an eagle kite from Professor Scratch, but it quickly becomes uncontrollable.
Can we build it? You know Rubble and his awesome crew have the tools for every job - because for every problem, there's always a construction solution!
Liberty and the Poms team up with the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay from being crushed by a giant, flying Top Hat.
Marshall and Skye solve a missing water mystery when a rooftop fire strikes Adventure Bay. Everest and the pups help Jake reclaim his mountain cabin from mischievous squirrels.
Kai invents a Bunzooka to send Bobbi's buns into space, but they end up damaging the Dinobird! Kai and Professor Scratch's upgrades to a Robo-Rose create a stinky cloud over the city!
When Tommy enters his first Rocket Race, Tim does everything possible to support his brother.
Tim tries to find a new rocket that's perfect for him.
Tim sets out to prove Kai's Dad is Captain DinoStar.
Carlita has transformed into an ice cream truck; before she can deliver sweet treats to all the Gabby Cats, she'll need ice cream, a menu and a song.
Gabby and Pandy blast off to Planet Caturn after CatRat gets stuck there looking for space cheese.

When the other Smurfs bale out of posing for Painter's masterpiece, he finds a new subject in Gargamel's Mother; when the Smurfs' favourite things start disappearing all over the Village, everyone gets worried and suspicious.

When Café Carl's pirate-themed restaurant gets caught in rough waters, the pups set sail with a new construction solution. Sierra Sparkle calls in help from Rubble & Crew to build a special experience for all her fans in Builder.
Carlos and Tracker set out to search for buried treasure, but end up stranded on an island with no way home.
Mayor Humdinger and his kitties accidentally set Lizzy's Lemonade Stand and parts of Foggy Bottom ablaze. It's up to the pups to extinguish the fires!
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.

It's time for playgroup, and Peppa and friends are thinking about what they want to be when they grow up. Some in the group want to be nurses, police officers and even pirates, but Peppa takes a little while to figure out what she wants to be.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
When a spell accidentally goes wrong, Ben and Holly grow to human size! Now they are able to play with Lucy and her friends and want to stay big forever.
The elves give the King some chickens from the Elf Farm so that he can have eggs whenever he likes.
Mr Elf is overworked so King Thistle sentences him to a holiday. He isn't too pleased, but Mrs Elf and Ben are overjoyed! Meanwhile, Nanny takes over the food deliveries.

Leo goes into the jungle with Tracker, and they find an injured monkey in a Monkey Temple full of traps. Mayor Humdinger has stolen a safe along with Meow meow, so the puppies and the cats do everything they can to get it back.
Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares stories that are playful.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Nanny's magic licence is out of date and in order to get a new one she must pass a test, set by the Wise Old Elf.
Holly is left in charge when King and Queen Thistle go away on important business, but ruling the Little Kingdom isn't as easy as it looks.
Thomas and Percy explore a brand-new track the evening before the route is opened.
Thomas and the other young engines encounter a stink monster that threatens to spread a stench all over Knapford!
Dora, Boots, and Vicky the vicuña must find lost musical instruments to save Sky Kingdom. Dora rescues Boots' special banana doll before the golden marmosets get their hands on it.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
Tim searches the kitchen, reads labels and ingredients to find a hogweed-free snack for Kai.

The Browns meet Shantee the lighthouse keeper when they arrive at the beach for their holiday. Paddington, Jonathan, and Judy become trainee lifeguards and end up rescuing Mr Brown with Taylor the lifeguard's help.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
When the fairies wake up to find that their wands are not working, the kingdom has to cope without any help from magic for the entire day.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre, and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a very funny puppet show.

Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep plays with Peppa. The boys don't want to play the same games as the girls, but they all agree that they like jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
When it comes to pancake making, Daddy Pig thinks he is a bit of an expert, but he has a tendency to flip the pancakes a bit too high.
George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand-new clothes. After trying on lots of new exciting outfits George finds an outfit that suits him just right!
At the park, all the leaves have turned red and yellow, and it's so windy that Peppa's ball blows into the pond and George's hat blows into a tree.
Peppa and George go ice skating, but they have never been before, and Peppa keeps falling over.
Peppa and her family have been on a trip to a mountain beauty spot. When Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a drain, Mr Bull offers to find them with his digger.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.
Mummy Pig dresses as a firefighter to practise fighting fires at the fire station with the other mummies. The fire brigade demonstrates how to do so effectively using their motto, Ready, Steady, Go.
For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.

While Peppa and her friends are at playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a lucky hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle. The project is a huge success, as the children gather fruit from their homes.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Peppa's playgroup are really enjoying Grampy Rabbit's talk about space rockets, until suddenly he loses his voice. Doctor Brown Bear must get him speaking again.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Peppa and her friends are busy building a desert island in a sandpit. They are all very proud of it, with its forest, lake, houses and shops. It's going splendidly, until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa teases George because he can't catch a ball properly. Mummy Pig suggests they play a game that will help George learn how to catch, called 'Piggy in the Middle'.
It is Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.
Baby Alexander is too young to talk until Peppa teaches him his first word.
Peppa and George realise that they have shadows and no matter what they do, they can't escape from them.
Peppa wins her first star for making a wonderful drawing of her house. Dad realises that he has never won a single star and is determined to solve the problem.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle. The family soon realise that her house is being pushed over by the tall tree next to it. Mr. Bull arrives and with his help they all manage to save Madame Gazelle's House and tree.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.
When Peppa and George go to the dentist for a check-up, Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white, but George's toy dinosaur is in need of a tooth clean.
Oh dear, Miss Rabbit's train has broken down and all her passengers need to get to work. So Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train, Gertrude.

What's that strange creature hovering in the sky? It's George's dinosaur balloon, but little George is finding it difficult to keep hold of his big balloon. Can anyone stop it from flying off to the moon?
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.
Peppa and family are at the school fair where the top prize in the raffle is a hot-air balloon ride.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
The children's favourite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving Playgroup. They are very sad to be losing her, but decide to throw a leaving party to give her a good send-off.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.
Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish there, Peppa must find a new friend for Goldie.
While enjoying a tea break, Mr Bull accidentally breaks his delicate teapot. He takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone, so Daddy sleeps underneath the stars.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives. The donkeys take Peppa and her family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Dad to face his fear of heights.
Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Mr Bull is building. They could also find out who their new neighbours are going to be.

Thaddäus will am Spielautomaten der Krossen Krabbe etwas gewinnen, aber auch als er all sein Geld verzockt hat, schafft er es nicht. SpongeBob hilft ihm schließlich. Und: Thaddäus' Sicherheitssystem beginnt zu leben.

Mr. Krabs verkauft die Krosse Krabbe an einen Fastfood-Konzern, weil er mehr Ruhe braucht. Aber bald bereut er seine Entscheidung. Thaddäus erzählt SpongeBob, dass sein Lachen ein Symptom einer schlimmen Krankheit ist.

SpongeBob und Patrick stoßen miteinander zusammen und befinden sich anschließend in einer mittelalterlichen Version von Bikini Bottom. Dort werden sie für edle Ritter gehalten und müssen Perla aus der Gewalt des bösen Zauberers befreien.

Mr. Krabs' Mutter verliebt sich in Plankton. Das passt ihrem Sohn natürlich gar nicht. Und: SpongeBob und Patrick freuen sich, denn der neue Film mit Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube kommt ins Kino. Aber es gibt eine große Enttäuschung.

Nachdem Patrick einen Schlag auf den Kopf bekommen hat, ist er plötzlich ein genialer Denker. SpongeBob gefällt der neue Patrick gar nicht. Sandy verschmilzt aus Versehen SpongeBob und Thaddäus zu einer Person. Wie kommen die beiden da wieder raus?

Mr. Krabs will sein Restaurant in ein extravagantes Hotel verwandeln, um mehr Geld zu verdienen. Also müssen SpongeBob und Thaddäus den Gästen ab jetzt alle Wünsche von den Augen ablesen. SpongeBob wird einfach kein Bootsfahrer.

Sandy muss sich etwas einfallen lassen, um ihre Erfindungen besser zu machen, um Geld zu bekommen. Ein berühmtes Gespenst, der Fliegende Holländer, übernachtet bei SpongeBob und erschrickt ihn die ganze Nacht, bis es langweilig wird.

Mr. Krabs möchte seiner Tochter den schönsten Geburtstag aller Zeiten bescheren. SpongeBob bekommt die Aufgabe, heimlich herauszufinden, was das perfekte Geschenk für sie wäre. Und: SpongeBob wird auf die Karate-Insel zu einem Turnier eingeladen.

SpongeBob muss einen neuen Bratenheber finden. Mr. Krabs baut einen Wunschbrunnen. Dort sollen die Gäste der Krossen Krabbe Münzen hineinwerfen, um einen Wunsch erfüllt zu bekommen. SpongeBob soll die Münzen herausholen.
Das Team der Krossen Krabbe versucht Krabbenburger auf den Tribünen eines Konzerts zu verkaufen.

Als Kunden ihre Haustiere in der Krossen Krabbe füttern, steht Mr. Krabs vor einer Entscheidung. Er muss sich entscheiden, ob er Leute oder Haustiere bedienen möchte. Karen schließt den Abfalleimer, als Plankton wieder eine Verabredung ruiniert.
Thaddäus verbringt einen Tag im Waschsalon. SpongeBob und Patrick suchen ein Wurmschwein.

Ein Kunde ruft in der Krossen Krabbe an und möchte eine Pizza nach Hause geliefert haben. Nun bietet das Restaurant zwar weder Pizza noch einen Lieferservice an, doch wenn es um den Umsatz geht, ändert Mr. Krabs gerne mal die Regeln.

SpongeBob entsorgt in der Stadt den ganzen Abfall, bis auf einen sturen Müll-Ball // SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs versuchen in Perlas Schule Krabbenburger zu servieren, ohne von der strengen Küchenchefin erwischt zu werden.
Als Patricks Zeit Kleiderschrank den Geist aufgibt, wird SpongeBobs Vergangenheit von zeitreisenden Eindringlingen umgeschrieben.
SpongeBob und Patrick suchen Thaddäus, nachdem sich sein Haus in einen Müllberg verwandelt hat.

SpongeBob kommt in den Besitz eines Zauberstabs und verursacht damit versehentlich überall, wo er hingeht, magisches Chaos. Am Freitag, dem 13., wird Mr. Krabs' extreme Abergläubigkeit für alle um ihn herum zur Belastung.

SpongeBob, Patrick und Mr. Krabs besuchen ein Spiel, um Perla beim Cheerleading zuzusehen. Patrick bleibt in der Kommentatorenkabine stecken, und Mr. Krabs stößt einen Anfeuerungsruf für Perla aus, um für die Krosse Krabbe zu werben. Abgelenkt gelangt der Ball zu Perla, die ein Tor erzielt, was dazu führt, dass sie in die Fußballmannschaft aufgenommen wird. Vor einem wichtigen Spiel motiviert SpongeBob Perla mit einem Anfeuerungsruf.
Als drei Freunde von Blaze in große Schwierigkeiten geraten, muss Blaze sie retten.

Dora und Boots helfen Swiper, sich wieder mit seinen Doppelgängern zu vereinen und es zu Omas Picknick zu schaffen. Außerdem helfen Dora und Boots Bateo der Fledermaus dabei, rechtzeitig zu einem Baseballspiel zu kommen.

Als Thaddäus den Auftrag erhält, alle Beschwerden von Kamp Koral zu beseitigen, bittet er SpongeBob und Patrick um Hilfe. Patrick bekommt einen Stern geschenkt, muss aber feststellen, dass die Vaterschaft für Unvorbereitete schwierig sein kann.

Plankton gewinnt einen Süßestes-Baby-Wettbewerb und wird das Gesicht einer Babybreimarke. Weil Thaddäus' zufälliges Porträt von SpongeBob in der Kunstwelt Wellen schlägt, hat er keine andere Wahl, als mehr davon zu produzieren.

B.Ö.S.E. fordert diesmal SpongeBob heraus, eine Lieferung innerhalb von zehn Minuten in ihr Versteck zu bringen. Mr. Krabs steckt in Pearls neuem Boot fest. Er muss so tun, als sei er der Motor, um nicht entdeckt zu werden.

Halmoni wählt Jack als Tanzpartner für den Trot-Tanzwettbewerb. Die neidische Lily will sich an Jack rächen. Min bittet Jack um einen Gefallen. Doch als er von Charlie gestört wird, müssen ihm Jack und Lily in die verlassenen Minen folgen.

Will ist überzeugt, während einer Hitzewelle die defekte Klimaanlage reparieren zu können und der Familie so helfen zu können. Als Jack und Lily aus dem Raben-Club austreten, in dem Ellie die Chefin ist, muss sie um ihre Freundschaft kämpfen.

Stein fordert Schere zu einem Bowlingspiel heraus, bei dem es um viel Geld geht. Als Stein bei einem Persönlichkeitsquiz das schlechteste Ergebnis erhält, versucht er allen zu beweisen, dass er weiß, wer er wirklich ist.

Papier will die Aufmerksamkeit seiner Freunde gewinnen, als diese mit Steins Freundin Kartoffel fasziniert sind. Die Freunde von Papier erfahren, dass dieser keine Pups-Witze mag. Daher nehmen sie sich vor, ihn damit zum Lachen zu bringen.

Lili organisiert zusammen mit den anderen Kleinkindern einen Ausbruch aus dem Kindergehege von Muhland. // Nach Jahren voller toller Geschenke von Clyde macht sich Lincoln auf die Suche nach dem ultimativen Geburtstagsgeschenk für ihn.
Als Zach die Bestnote in einem Test bekommt, hält er sich fortan für ein Genie, das nicht mehr lernen muss.

Der Club muss die Schulbelegschaft davon abhalten, Cupcakes zu essen, die sie in einen Kobold verwandeln. // Leni macht ein Praktikum bei Mariella Moss. Aber Lenis Freund demonstriert gegen ihre neue Kollektion.

Um Lori zu helfen, besorgt ihr Luan einen Job im Bohnen-Café, dessen Chefin Luan ist. Lana wird derweil von Lily verfolgt. Sie schafft es nicht, ihre kleine Schwester loszuwerden, die ihr überallhin wie ein Schatten folgt.
Aus Angst, erneut durch die Sportprüfung zu fallen, wendet sich Lucy an den Bestatter-Club.

Patrick und SpongeBob lieben das Quallenfischen, obwohl sie dabei stets erfolglos sind, nun wollen sei auch Thaddäus an dieses Hobby heranführen. Plankton hat es wieder auf die Geheimformel abgesehen und nistet sich dafür in SpongeBobs Hirn ein.
1. Geschichte: Plankton zieht in eine andere Stadt. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob richtet mit Neptuns Dreizack Unheil an.
Sandy gibt ihren Freunden spezielle Salzwasserbäume, die jedoch viel Aufmerksamkeit brauchen.

SpongeBob glaubt, dass Plankton nur aus Einsamkeit so böse ist, und versucht, sich mit ihm anzufreunden. Die beiden haben tatsächlich Spaß miteinander. Doch Plankton benutzt diese Freundschaft, um an das Geheimrezept der Krossen Krabbe zu gelangen.

Karen rät Plankton dazu, Werbemaßnahmen zu ergreifen, was nicht sofort Erfolg bringt. Patrick kommt allerdings mit einem Slogan um die Ecke, der es in sich hat: "Fraß macht Maß!". Das zieht die Massen an und plötzlich lastet Druck auf Patrick.

Karen ist Planktons Computer-Ehefrau. Doch sie wird durch eine neuere Version ersetzt: Karen 2.0. Die ursprüngliche Karen muss sich aus diesem Grund eine neue Beschäftigung suchen. Und die findet sie auch: in der "Krossen Krabbe".

Plankton entwickelt einen hinterhältigen Plan, um seine Restaurantkette am Strand zu erweitern. Er versucht, SpongeBob zu manipulieren und dazu zu bringen, aggressiv und gemein zu werden und ihn auf seine Seite zu ziehen.

In seinem neuesten Vorhaben schlüpft Plankton in die Rolle eines Wünsche erfüllenden Flaschengeistes, mit dem Ziel, eine wertvolle Geheimformel zu stehlen. Die Frage, die sich stellt, ist, ob Plankton mit dieser List endlich Erfolg haben wird. Die Spannung steigt, ob sein Plan aufgehen wird oder nicht.

Hank gründet eine Nachbarschaftswache. Der Anlass sind mysteriöse Verbrechen. Um sein eigenes Geheimnis zu schützen, bekennt Max sich schuldig. Phoebe ist sich sicher, dass er es nicht war, und nun liegt es an der Familie, die Verbrechen aufzuklären.

Phoebes Schwarm lädt sie zum Schulball ein, als ein Komet die Superkräfte der ganzen Familie auf den Kopf stellt. Max und Phoebe müssen nun zusammenbleiben, um Schlimmeres zu verhindern. Darüber sind sie beide nicht sonderlich erfreut.

Schere weigert sich, den Müll hinauszubringen. Papier versucht, ihn zur Erfüllung der Aufgabe zu bringen, bis ein historisches Königreich aus lebenden Abfällen die Wohnung übernimmt, dessen Prinzessin Stein nach der perfekten Romanze sucht.
Stein macht sich auf die Suche nach einem Artefakt. Papier und Schere unterstützen Stein.
Die Familie Star fährt zu ihrem Lieblingsort und Bunny begibt sich auf ein mittägliches Abenteuer.

Pinky ist davon überzeugt, dass JJs neue Lederjacke bedeutet, dass ihre wöchentlichen Rollenspiele vorbei sind - und damit auch ihre Freundschaft! // Um das Verbrechen des Jahrhunderts zu lösen, hilft Pinky Bob dabei, undercover zu gehen.

Grouse versucht alles, um Lance und seine Familie wieder aus Royal Woods zu vertreiben, nachdem sie nebenan eingezogen sind. // Nachdem Lynn eine Online-Sportshow veröffentlicht hat, lernt sie schnell, wie sich mehr Klicks und Fans generieren lassen.
Shane findet keinen Anschluss an seinem ersten Tag an der Royal Woods High und bittet Leni, Luna und Luan um Hilfe.
Lola beschwert sich über ein Haar im Essen und findet heraus, dass sie sich so Gratissachen ergaunern kann.

Als eine neue Geheimformel für die Krabbenburger auftaucht, hat das schwerwiegende Folgen für ganz Bikini Bottom. Nur SpongeBob kann jetzt noch helfen. Außerdem gehen Mr. Krabs und Plankton auf eine Bootsfahrschule - SpongeBob kennt sich aus.

1. Geschichte: Mr. Krabs entsorgt den anfallenden Abfall der Krossen Krabbe, illegal in der ganzen Stadt. Als er deshalb Ärger bekommt, trägt er SpongeBob und Thaddäus auf, aufzuräumen. 2. Geschichte: Thaddäus' Garten wird von einem Seehasen durchwühlt. SpongeBob findet das Tier aber so süß, dass er sich darum kümmern will.
Patricks Limonadenstand ist erfolglos, bis er eine geheime Zutat von Thaddäus bekommt.

Im letzten Kampf verwandelt der Bösling sich in ein riesiges Monster. Wenn Max und die Halbritter ihn besiegen können und Mumblin einen Weg findet, ein Zeitportal zu öffnen, könnten sie die Welt vielleicht noch davor bewahren, zu verschwinden.
Patrick hat einen Gutschein für ein kostenloses Eis gefunden, der jedoch abgelaufen zu sein scheint.
Lily introduces Jack to her favourite video game, but when he keeps losing, Jack binges the game and turns into a toxic troll; slice of life vignettes that illustrate the modern-day family dynamic.

When Halmoni chooses Jack over Lil to be her Trot dance competition partner, jealous Lil seeks revenge; Min asks Jack to run a simple errand, but Charlie the gibbon intervenes, sending Jack and Lil chasing after him.
Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul mate. Simon and Alvin decide to rebel and launch their own campaigns for class president.
Simon is ecstatic when he is elected as the school's safety monitor. Dave brings the Chipmunks on a technology-free camping trip.
Phoebe visits her boyfriend's shy brother, but the mild-mannered boy discovers his evil side when he gets his hands on one of Max's inventions.
Phoebe's relationship with her superhero boyfriend is put to the test when he is offered an assignment overseas.
A new student, Shawn, takes Henry's spot on the basketball team, but Henry suspects he may be older than he claims. Captain Man needs the help of an old friend.
Henry's got a big date, but things don't go quite as planned after he's accidentally exposed to a strange device in the Man Cave.
The Marsupilamis are great at making music, and when a music producer hears it Jade says it was her. Lalou's cat adoption day doesn't go smoothly, when Punch is adopted by mistake.
When Lazy loses his pillow, only Baby's cuddly toy will let him get back to sleep.
Rowena enchants Voltaire, compelling his obedience; Jokey's prank backfires, resulting in all Smurfs being transformed into pebbles.
Begonia, Lily, and Blossom decide to teach Wild a lesson after he steals their cupcakes.
Clumsy and Dimwitty want to help Rowena cure her plant, but little do they know it's all a scam to capture Smurfs; Rowena turns Vanity and Storm into dolls.

When Miss Miller gets robbed, Eleanor and Theodore promise to find the culprit and bring them to justice. Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she so desperately needs to learn.
Coach Dobbins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game. Dave has a problem when each of the Chipettes wants him to be their date to the Father Daughter Dance.
Paper believes he's been accepted into a prestigious college only to learn that he's been placed into the third grade, which is harder than he expected.
Rock, Paper and Scissors are three best friends who share a flat together and compete over everything. Week to week, they have tiny problems that always get out of hand.

The family prepares for war, AKA a trip to the local Asian market. After their battle to procure a rare cookie, Jack feels more part of the family. The Groom & Board gets a bad review. Lily tries to find the culprit and corr.

Lil's favourite boba shop is closing! The kids try to save the café using pucker limes, but are quickly forced to save Canyon Valley from the pucker. Lil and Min both realize how similar they are to their mums and set out to distinguish themselves.
Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life. Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet.

Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in order to complete an art assignment for art class. Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner while Theodore keeps Alvin distracted.
Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp, but he has to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom first; the field team strives to help him escape.
A party in the park drags the Boss Baby into a dogfight with his old nemesis, Puppy Co.'s Bug the Pug, and the loser must don the "Collar of Shame."
New adventures for The Thundermans unfold after Phoebe and Max are sent undercover to handle a new threat in the seaside town of Secret Shores, and bring Chloe along to develop her superhero talent.
Billy brings a new sidekick, Steve, to town and wants him to join the T-Force; Phoebe and Max agree to consider him, but when they eventually reject Steve for having a very lame power, he turns evil.
The American Football show that serves up everything you need to know about the game with a dash of slime thrown into the mix.
Desperate to avenge last year's humiliating loss, the Chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory.
In Hamdonia, Prince Shmeat and Tofu Todd embark on a quest to defeat the Maw. After learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.
Patrick overstays his welcome at the SquarePants home. GrandPat attempts to injure himself for Nurse Helga's attention.

The Chipmunks try to keep Dave from getting on the Internet after a performance he posts gets negative comments. The Chipmunks along with Kevin and Cheesy decide to crash Bo Carter's birthday yacht party after not being invited.
Alvin sounds the alarm when he believes Theodore has joined a motorcycle gang of vampires; When Brittany declines Alvin's help for a talent show, he convinces Jeanette to enter, putting them at odds.

Rock, Paper and Scissors have a great time birdwatching until they return home to find the birds have started watching them; the trio discovers they're trapped in a nightmare and must wake up before one of them wets the bed.

Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car registered as an emotional support convertible and brings it with him everywhere. The trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back.
The brothers stay home with a babysitter while their parents go out for the night, and Boss Baby wants to make her look bad - but she is just too good.
While Tim works overtime to do good in the neighbourhood, Staci and Boss Baby go undercover to rescue Jimbo from a house that's crawling with cats.

Chloe struggles with her leadership skills; when a villain attacks her school field trip, Max and Phoebe have to put Chloe in charge while they try to take down the villain and defuse his dangerous astronomical weapon.
Max misses being famous and having fans, so he decides to break Booch's sandwich-stacking record to be famous again; Chloe rallies behind Booch, so that she can take back her record.
Dave gets temporary amnesia so the boys decide to trick him into letting them skip school, and go on a skiing trip instead.

Chuck moves in with the Wylde-Paks after Lily and Jack accidentally destroy his house. They must hide his awful habits from their parents. Seeking closure on her favourite K-Drama, Lily films her own finale with her family as the cast and crew.
The Groom & Board gets a surprise inspection, but the broken pipe Jack and Lil neglected to fix might ruin them all. Chuck's got a new hustle.
Tempers flare when the Chipmunks get stuck in traffic on the way to a show. Simon becomes annoyed by constant requests to fix things and plays dumb until he gets a thank-you.
Theodore is passed over when Alvin and Eleanor train as lifeguards; Miss Croner's cherries are lost.
When a client says 'You're my favourite babysitter ever', Sam and Cat debate which of them he meant. They compete for their clients' affection to see who really is the best babysitter.
When Sam and Cat agree to babysit Goomer while Dice goes away, they misapply Goomer's medication. The mistake with the medication causes him to temporarily lose his eyesight before a big match.

Sadie, Lay Lay and the Alexander family go to church for their monthly visit; Sadie tries to show everyone she is ready to become a junior deacon; Lay Lay struggles with the guilt of eating Bryce's special ice cream and experiences strange glitches.
After a prank gone wrong, Sadie and Lay Lay try to trick Principal Willingham into believing that Sadie is Lay Lay's grandmother for a parent/teacher conference.
When Phoebe and Max's friends begin spending time with each other, the twins worry that they will be stuck together all the time.
Kid Danger reveals to Captain Man that he doesn't want to be stuck in Swellview and be his sidekick forever. To make matters worse, Kid Danger is recruited by another town to be their hero.
Captain Man's old sidekick and nemesis, Drex, returns from the past with an army of cavemen to finish off Captain Man once and for all. Kid Danger may be the only one who can save Captain Man now.
The Templetons cross paths with a "Cat Cop" with connections to cunning villain Bootsy Calico, and Tim masters the art of negotiation.
An after-hours break-in to save Boss Baby's job transforms Tim into the daring Tim Templeton: Unleashed.
Rock, Paper and Scissors want to take the perfect photo for their Christmas card but run into a problem; Paper and Scissors get into trouble by pretending to be someone else.
A "free" family holiday comes at a cost when Tim is tasked with keeping a plane full of babies calm on an eight-hour flight to Paris.

When Pencil comes over to watch a horror movie, Paper worries he'll be too scared to handle it. There's a light wind, and Paper is far from home. Rock and Scissors try to save him before he blows away forever.

Squidward is rushed to the hospital when SpongeBob accidentally slams the door on Squidward's face. A very windy day in Bikini Bottom is blowing air through SpongeBob's holes resulting in a chorus of pretty flute-like sounds.
It's snowing so SpongeBob and Patrick try to show Squidward how much fun it can be to play in the snow. Mr. Krabs has a garage sale and sells SpongeBob the most valuable of items.
SpongeBob must write an 800-word essay for boating school but gets distracted easily. When Patrick's parents come over for Starfish Day, Patrick gets upset that they still think he isn't very smart.

SpongeBob and Pat are fascinated by the snow they see inside the Treedome and want to play in it, but Sandy is hibernating for the winter. SpongeBob grows more and more jealous as Gary spends more time with Patrick.
With the Krusty Krab's new open 24 hours policy, the employees must work around the clock. Mr Krabs loses his shell right before a big reunion with his old buddies.

SpongeBob and Patrick try to help Sandy rid her Tree Dome of fleas. When Patrick accidentally takes SpongeBob's doughnut, he is wracked with guilt over his crime. SpongeBob battles a persistent speck of food that is on a plate.
Plankton hires Patrick to create advertising slogans for the Chum Bucket. SpongeBob helps Plankton find the perfect anniversary gift for Karen.
The Dinghies travel to outer space; after discovering his empty shell, Narlene and Nobby disguise themselves at Camp Master Krabs.
After SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy are banned from playing pirate outside, they decide to turn their cabin into a pirate ship. SpongeBob pretends to be a jellyfish for research purposes.
After SpongeBob and Patrick eat an experiment, Plankton must counteract the monstrous side effects. Elsewhere, Mr Crab must find a babysitter for Pearl, but she proves to be demanding to care for.
Patrick's big sister, Samantha, arrives for a visit. Sandy and Plankton bond over a shared love for science.
Squidward finds SpongeBob's diary, and starts reading it out loud in the Krusty Krab. SpongeBob once again fails his driving test, forcing Mrs Puff to think outside the box and off the road.
SpongeBob must figure out how to do his job after accidentally shrinking himself. Squidward invents a new sport to get back at SpongeBob and Patrick for annoying him.
Krabs puts Squidward in charge of all camp complaints. Patrick received a star on his birthday.
Patrick's injury recovery causes trouble for the camp. Rea and Roh learn to support themselves.
SpongeBob watches Mr Krabs' house while he's away, and takes extreme measures to make sure no one breaks in. Squidward is forced to room with Patrick.
Granny Tentacles helps Squidward collect his paper delivery money from Cecil. The Star family house runs away from home.
Patrick helps Squidward with his newspaper delivery job to compensate for injuring him. In the midst of a typical day of scavenging, the Dartfish family discover a thief in the Star home.
Sandy gets a brand-new suit. SpongeBob's newest friend is a hungry parasite inside of him.
The Roxie sisters go their separate ways; The Dinghy cabin kids discover life after dark.
When the circus comes to town and steals his customers away, Mr. Krabs tries to sabotage the show; Sandy spends the day solving everyone's issues, only to return home to her own monster of a problem.
The Star Family heads to their favourite resort in 'Gas Station Vacation', then in 'Bunny the Barbarian', Bunny goes on a midday adventure to a forgotten age.
Patrick hires more Patricks. Pat-Thos shares a Hamdonian tale of love and pork products.
Watching reruns of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy. SpongeBob loses his self-confidence when an arrogant customer claims SpongeBob forgot to put pickles on his Krabby Patty.

Patrick has a box and won't show SpongeBob what's inside. SpongeBob's curiosity gets the best of him. Squidward's old rival brags to Squid about his famous marching band. Feeling outdone, Squid says he has a band too.
After watching a movie where robots take over the world, SpongeBob thinks Mr. Krabs is a robot. SpongeBob and Patrick find a baby clam and decide to raise it as their own.
In order to avoid doing chores, Sandy invents a "Smart Cabin"; Squidward takes over as Camp Master.
It's standup comedy night at Kamp Koral, and the campers are ready to laugh until they scream. Patrick gets confused with a young Seasquatch while out in the woods.
Mr Krabs sends SpongeBob and Patrick to spy on Plankton. SpongeBob and Squidward star in an instructional boating video. Mr Krabs pits SpongeBob against Squidward.

Mr Krabs' granddad is coming to town. However, Mr Krabs is nervous because his swarthy pirate granddad thinks that Mr Krabs is a pirate, too. Squidward is a member of a secret society and SpongeBob decides he wants to join.
Squidina has to direct her school holiday play, but her script was mangled by Patrick.
The Star family find themselves getting smaller and smaller. Patrick's evil twin cousin shows up to ruin Patrick's reputation.
SpongeBob and Patrick play hide and seek and SpongeBob searches the world for Patrick. Plankton masquerades as Gary to steal the Krabby Patty formula.

Patrick becomes the superhero Patrick-Man, who intends to clean up Bikini Bottom, whether it wants it or not. Gary becomes obsessed with his new red ball, forcing SpongeBob to take drastic measures to intervene.
The campers meet two backwoods narwhals named Narlene and Nobby, who treat them to a sweet surprise.
Krabs reignites his passion for clowning. Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie.
The Stars run a Patrick Show theme park in their home. Patrick and Squidina embark on a quest to find the lost bathroom.
Grandpa prevents his precious memories from being sold at a family yard sale.
Karen tells the fairytale of a nerd trying to steal an action figure from his three little neighbours. Squidward hosts a secret We Hate SpongeBob Club at his house.
Lady Upturn becomes Squidward's patron and introduces his music to her rich friends; Squidward tries to disprove aliens until he has a close encounter with one.
Bunny sends Squidina to camp, so Patrick works with new staff in. The Star family enjoys a cruise ship holiday in outer space.
Patrick accidentally hypnotises Bikini Bottom into GrandPats. Squidina leads Patrick on a grocery shopping mission.
The Patrick Show sells merchandise in order to fund its second season; Patrick hosts a series of game shows.

Plankton creates a clone of himself and Mr Krabs, but neither restaurant is safe from the newcomer. Squidward gleefully switches jobs with a bus driver for an easy ride until SpongeBob and Patrick climb aboard.
Plankton poses as a wish-granting genie in his latest scheme to get the secret formula. Mr Krabs' new Krabby soup is a hit until some heat-loving hippies move into the soup vat.
After his house gets infested, Squidward checks into a hotel where a different kind of pest awaits him. SpongeBob and Patrick get duped into babysitting a grouchy old lady who keeps trying to escape.

When Pat suddenly grows a very grown-up beard, he decides it's time to act like a grownup, too. While preparing to give an oral report for boating school, SpongeBob realises that he's got a horrible case of stage fright.
Squidward bets that SpongeBob can't go a day without crying. Mrs Puff has to work through her summer break at the Krusty Krab.

SpongeBob has to run the Krusty Krab for 15 whole minutes, but is led astray by Squidward. SpongeBob must be at Patrick's birthday party, help Sandy with her presentation, and help Mr Krabs build a telescope, all at the same time.

Stan is going on a literal busman's holiday to Spain with other crew members and decides to get a tan by sun-bathing at the grave-yard. Unfortunately a tramp steals his uniform, and he has to break into his holiday money in order to buy a new one.
Arthur's ambition to own a Rolls is jeopardised when Terry has to protect a widowed garage owner.
Sharon gets a visit from estranged husband Chris, seeking a quick divorce so that he can marry his new love Angie, a blind woman, but Tracey has a few doubts.

TV repairman and unwitting time traveller Gary Sparrow has been trapped in the past for the last 17 years. It is now 1962, and in the midst of his birthday celebrations at The Royal Oak with his wife Phoebe, his teenage son Michael and their old friend Reg, he realises that he could go to the maternity hospital and actually see himself being born.
Robin fails his catering examination, and it looks as if he'll be leaving London to become a part of 'Tripp's Extruding Tubings, Southampton Limited'.
Featuring the Boomtown Rats, Suzi Quatro and more, all in the best possible taste.
Team 'That's TV' present a round-up of the local news for Greater Belfast, Northern Ireland.
Mildred decides that she and her husband George will celebrate their wedding anniversary in style at a posh London hotel. However, chaos ensues when a shady businessman mistakes George for a hit man.
Harold has arranged a poker game with a few friends. Albert is morally outraged by the idea of gambling. However, he sees Harold is being cheated by his 'friends' and decides to help.
While out on his rounds Harold falls for a wealthy married woman. Albert is unimpressed and tries to talk Harold out of making a fool of himself.
Harold plans to travel the world, so Albert goes into a home, but the future holds surprises for them both.

Harold buys a job lot of coffins and stores them in the living room. Albert, who's very superstitious, strongly objects. He moves into the stable to sleep until they have been moved, leaving Harold alone in the house at night.

When Blakey slips up on a chip on Stan's bus the company decrees that all staff should go on a First Aid course which they are obliged to pass. Stan has only twenty-four hours to swot up if he hopes to pass.
The toilet in the Butler household was installed by Stan's grandfather, and it is now time for a new one. However, Blakey has problems with how it travels to its new home.
A new batch of young girls training to be conductresses arrives, out of which Sally is the girl who turns all the men's heads. Jack and Stan seriously compete with each other for her attentions.
Stan samples the home-brewed beer which he has just made. It is very, very strong indeed, so much so that when he goes to work he is already tipsy and Blakey breathalyses him.

Olive wants to re-decorate her and Arthur's bedroom, so Stan gets two tins of paint from the depot. They are the bus colours, red and yellow, which Arthur mixes to make green. He omits to add hardeners so that the paint is very slow-drying.
Jack goes out on a date with Fatima, an exotic dancer who uses a snake in her act, but he does not want the snake to go with them so he puts it in Stan's bag.
At the social club Stan's Mum meets a man called Wilfred and her behaviour changes drastically. She stays out late with him and buys clothes more suited to a younger woman in addition to a wig.
Technology takes over at the depot as a new radio control system is introduced, but Stan and Jack can be guaranteed to cause chaos as they get to grips with the airwaves.
On an exceptionally foggy night Stan refuses to carry on with the journey unless someone walks in front of the bus with a torch.
Young Mr Grace has died and the Grace Brothers department store has closed. The former staff attend a reading of his will, and find they have inherited a hotel.
After their first night in their own hotel, the former staff of Grace Brothers are settling into their new roles. However, they still need to come up with money to get the hotel running.
Mrs Slocombe finds herself in court for stealing a horse-drawn cart and Mr Humphries' relationship with Mavis Moulterd continues to develop.
Arthur makes an investment in corporate entertainment, but discovers the world of West End clubs and casinos conceals many pitfalls.

Gavin's mother Dorothy arrives unexpectedly but doesn't stay around very long. Jack, Janice's admirer, also turns up but overstays his welcome. Meanwhile, Telle and The Oracle have a big date though drink leads to some confusion about who is a virgin, and everyone is invited to Mel and Madge's wedding on the beach.
A romantic stroll on the beach is rudely interrupted as Mel and Madge's most memorable day of their lives soon becomes exactly that, but not in the way they would have liked.

Gary Sparrow is an unhappily married TV repairman, who one day unwittingly walks into a time warp. Totally disorientated, he thinks he's in a 1940s theme pub, until he falls in love with the landlord's daughter.
Rigsby drums up support for his own candidate as the local elections get under way.
The boisterous Brits in Benidorm reel from the shocking events at Madge's wedding. Mick ends up behind bars, Madge and Janice end up lost with a stranger, and the Solana becomes a crime scene.
Featuring 25 acts who all achieved their 15 minutes of fame with one massive song, then never hit the UK Top 20 again.
25 singalongs made famous in the theatre, on TV and at the movies. Expect The Partridge Family, Evita and Watership Down, plus a good dollop of Bond, Grease, and Saturday Night Fever.
A music playlist featuring a selection of classic hits spanning the year 1970.
Classic hits from just one year, 1971.
Playing 60 minutes of hits and headlines from the year of Apollo 13, The Beatles split and the launch of Skippy the Bush Kangaroo in the UK.
60 minutes of hits and headlines from the year Gary Barlow, David Tennant and Clare Balding were born. And the UK said goodbye to pounds, shillings & pence as we went decimal!
Playing 60 minutes of hits and headlines from a year of major cultural debuts, including 'Jesus Christ Superstar', 'Are You Being Served?' and George, Zippy and Bungle in 'Rainbow'.
60 minutes of hits and headlines from the year the UK entered Europe, Led Zeppelin conquered America, and 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon Common said hello to The Wombles!
Playing 60 minutes of hits and headlines from the year Ronnie Barker started receiving Porridge in Slade Prison, and the band Slade topped the album chart twice.
Experience the magic of the 70s, where every beat was a spell and every song a timeless enchantment.
They say music goes in cycles. Well for a period in the 70s we decided to celebrate all things 50s! Showaddywaddy's Dave Bartram has hits from Alvin Stardust, Mud, Darts and Grease.
We're going back to a time when Little Eva was telling everybody to do the loco-motion and The Beatles claimed they were the walrus. Expect to see all of your fave artists as we rewind to the 60s.
From the Everly Brothers in 1960 to The Beatles in '69 - here are 35 songs that topped the hit parade across the decade. Not 'arf pop pickers!
Celebrating the colourful world of glam rock, novelty pop and unforgettable chart hits that defined a distinctive era in UK music. Expect TV themes, Eurovision and plenty of glitter!
From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the party hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?
Long considered a 70s style icon himself, Tony Blackburn sails through some sensational fashions, from Elvis and The Partridge Family in 1970 to Squeeze and Gary Newman in 1979.
Sniff that heady waft of Brut mixed with cheap perfume as you hit a dance floor for our playlist of top 70s tunes in your cheesecloth shirt or nylon blouse.
Dance floor action with 20 extended mixes and king-size videos of '80s classics. From Aztec Camera and A-Ha to Queen, Visage and Whitney Houston. Mark Goodier is on the ones and twos!
It's the weekend, and we're showing out! Classic pop that has stood the test of time.
This was the decade of the glitter dress and shiny outfits! Check out what Jacko is wearing - camp is too small a word.
Another episode of the Heritage Chart - new music by heritage acts! With Mike Read.
The UK's First Lady of Soul selects her 20 favourite girls of the '80s. Expect Tracy Chapman, Grace Jones, Kate Bush and Whitney.
Big hair, big voices, big videos and big songs! It's the battle of two '80s pop rock legends, Cher and Tina Turner!
From the decade that invented the genre - non-stop powerful love songs, back to back.
NOW 80s rolls out five hours of the fiercest females! From Cyndi and Madonna to Whitney, Bananarama and Kylie, it is wall-to-wall sing-alongs and unapologetic 80s fabulousness!
A non-stop ticket to the ultimate retro rave! We crank up the neon and hit the dance floor with the most electrifying feel-good music videos the 80s had to offer.
Ten fabulous videos from the UK Queen of '80s Pop, Kim Wilde! Including six top 10s and her duet with Junior.
With just five years as a partnership, Andrew and George produced these 10 chart hits in the mid 1980s. George went on to greater things, but what happened to lovely Andrew?
Forget about historical sales - this is the chart that really matters today - Mark Goodier with the most streamed Xmas songs in the last decade, many of them over a billion times!
